subject.title: fix(xai): respect ssrfPolicy and request.allowPrivateNetwork in image_generate

question: Should xAI image generation adopt the full configured provider request object, including headers, proxy, TLS, auth, and private-network policy, rather than a private-network-only seam?
rationale: The canonical useConfiguredRequest path cleanly fixes the reported bug, but it changes more operator-controlled request behavior than the PR title and proof demonstrate, requiring explicit owner intent.

options.title: Approve full request adoption
options.body: Keep the canonical path, require current-head guarded-request proof, and accept that all sanitized xAI request overrides apply to image calls.

options.title: Narrow to network policy
options.body: Use or add a shared scoped seam that forwards only private-network authorization without activating unrelated request overrides.

recommendation.title: Approve full request adoption
recommendation.body: Keep the canonical path, require current-head guarded-request proof, and accept that all sanitized xAI request overrides apply to image calls.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the per-provider request override contract and are best positioned to confirm its intended capability coverage.
